summary.tldr: Creates Criminal Code offences for stealing or possessing property of cultural or religious significance.
what_it_does: Creates a separate Criminal Code offence for theft of property that has cultural or religious significance.
Makes theft of such property punishable as an indictable offence with up to 10 years in prison, or as a summary conviction offence.
Creates a separate offence for possessing cultural or religious property when it was stolen in the theft offence.
Makes possession of such property punishable as an indictable offence with up to 5 years in prison, or as a summary conviction offence.
Adds the new theft offence to the Criminal Code definition of “offence” in section 183.
summary.background: The bill adds a new section 333.3 to the Criminal Code for theft and possession of property of cultural or religious significance.
